statement.notes: 1. 'Operating_expenses' calculated as sum of: Operating costs, Product development expenses, Selling and marketing expenses, General and administrative expenses, Amortization and impairment of intangible assets, and Impairment of goodwill. 'Other net income' was excluded from the operating expense sum as it is a separate income line. 2. 'Net_income' mapped to the line 'Net income' (not the attributable to shareholders line). 3. 'Taxes' mapped to 'Income tax expense'. 4. 'Interest_expenses' mapped directly. 5. Period labels kept exactly as shown in the statement columns. 6. Parentheses in source indicate negatives; converted to negative numbers. 7. USD period included as it is a distinct column in the source table.
